facts.business: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited is a diversified automotive retail enterprise dealing in passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and electric mobility through dealerships of Maruti Suzuki, Tata Motors, Honda, JLR, Bharat Benz, Audi, and Ather, supported by sales and service networks across multiple states.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Reduce Kerala revenue to below 50%; target double-digit growth from new geographies
Scale Audi volumes; explore further luxury brand additions; target high-ASP premiumisation
Deepen Ather network; evaluate 4W EV OEM partnerships; e-Vitara readiness underway
guidance_or_targets.value: Ather network deepening and 4W EV partnerships

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No fraud reported under Section 143(12); Secretarial Audit Report contains no qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer

key_risks: Elevated debt from expansion & acquisitions leading to higher interest burden and elevated Debt/EBITDA
IndAS acquisition adjustments impacting reported profitability in FY26 (one-time in nature)
MSIL supply constraints in Kerala causing volume pressure
Service segment volume decline (mid-single digit in FY26)
West Asia geopolitical conflict causing CV supply disruptions, fuel price volatility, and freight rate impact
Kerala geographic concentration exposing to region-specific macro and political risks
OEM alliancing risk including high MSIL dependence and risk of missing OEM targets
EV disruption from shift in customer preferences, new entrant competition
Cybersecurity risks including data theft and business disruption
facts.related_party_note: Mr. John K. Paul and Mr. Francis K. Paul are brothers; Mr. Naveen Philip is their nephew. No other directors are related. Non-executive directors hold no shares or convertible instruments.
